The decisive mistake was the AquaticEcosystems_InvasiveSpecies_Expert's claim of a completed manual verification. It had no working access to the USGS database (it said so at step 4), yet at step 5 it reported that "upon manual verification" the records confirmed 33040 and 33037 and declared the task complete. That unverified answer was then accepted by the other agents and locked in, so the wrong zip codes were never checked against the source.
